description: This file defines the implementation of the DataElement class and related functionality in the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes a CRC32 checksum calculation, buffer management, and data copying for linked data elements.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Class responsible for handling data elements with CRC32 checksum calculation.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Class handling linked list of data buffers with buffer management and copying functionalities.

methods.name: DataElement::CRC32
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 checksum over a specified segment of the buffer.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves data from the buffer, possibly spanning multiple linked elements if boundary is crossed.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets data into the buffer, handling boundary crossing and linked elements.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another linked data element starting at a specified offset.

methods.name: uint32_t CRC32(const uint64_t offset,const uint64_t size) const
uint64_t Copy(const uint64_t offset,const LinkedDataElement & copy)
void GetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,uint8_t * buffer) const
void SetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,const uint8_t * buffer)
